test_objective: Check that you can update a subscription: If isActive is equal to false and expiresAt is not present, then status shall be updated to "paused", if and only if, the previous value of status was different than "expired"

test_cases.name: 029_09_01 Update Subscription Status To Paused
test_cases.doc: Check that you can update a subscription: If isActive is equal to false and expiresAt is not present, then status shall be updated to "paused", if and only if, the previous value of status was different than "expired"
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/subscriptions/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Subscription Retrieve with the following data: and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${subscription_id}'
}
